_note: 01_01 §4.3 mechanical lock — Zone-1 anode shank: annular ratchet barbs (§4.3 A) + DIN-471 retaining groove (§4.3 B). Ø11 = founder anode Ø (HW.33). Ratchet 30°/70° at h=0.28 satisfies all four §4.3 numbers (h, base≈0.59, α, β). Self-supporting (60° downface, Ti64 LPBF Sa≈15µm) ONLY printed gentle-ramp-down as a SEPARATE part (01_01 §4.3 A); this shank prints WITH the gyroid anode, whose tip-down (01_02 §1.6) puts the steep β face DOWN at 20° from horizontal — not self-supporting, open verdict 00_07 HW.26 G4 (supports · re-derived α/β · tip-up). Groove = real DIN-471 for an Ø11 shaft (width 1.1 × depth 0.25; canon §4.3 '0.8×0.6' was off-spec), CNC post-DMLS. Pull-out 3–5× / PEEK 150°C click = FEA (Гусак HW.3.IS) + bench, NOT asserted here.

notes.material: V-free Ti alloy - same body as the Zone-1 gyroid anode (01_02 2.5, founder 2026-06-21): alloy NOT SELECTED until the Stage-2 coin bake-off (00_07 HW.24); Ti-6Al-4V is the price baseline only, NOT the material of this part
notes.process: SLM/DMLS, same build cycle as the Zone-1 gyroid anode (01_01 §3 step 1). Build ORIENTATION NOT SPECIFIED - an open verdict (00_07 HW.26 G4): the anode's tip-down (01_02 §1.6) puts this shank's free end UP, so the steep barb face (beta 70 deg from the axis) faces DOWN at 20 deg from horizontal and does NOT self-support; the 60 deg self-supporting downface of 01_01 4.3 A holds only for a lock printed ramp-down as a separate part. External supports, re-derived alpha/beta and tip-up are each a verdict - do not choose one at the machine
notes.post_process: HIP (01_02 §1.7); DIN-471 retaining-ring groove — CNC post-DMLS (§4.3 B, +15 min/anchor)
notes.surface_finish: As-printed, NOT etched — and that follows from the mandatory production ORDER, not from a finish spec: 01_02 1.3 fixes print+HIP -> hot press-fit assembly Ti/PEEK/Ti -> EAAE -> dehydrogenation bake -> functionalisation, so this surface is already inside the PEEK joint when the anchor is etched. The dual-scale Sa/Sv requirement of 01_02 1.2 is for the gyroid wall and does NOT apply here. The as-printed finish of the barb faces is NOT SPECIFIED: the Sa about 15 um of 01_01 4.3 A belongs to a 60 deg self-supporting downface, which this integrated shank does not have at the anode's tip-down - its steep face prints DOWN at 20 deg, and what that face looks like depends on the open orientation verdict (00_07 HW.26 G4). (The consequence is ours; the ORDER is canon.) ATTENTION - this is a CONSEQUENCE, not an instruction, and it holds on two conditions canon does not carry: (1) the ORDER stands - it sits under an open verdict that can move EAAE before assembly (00_07 HW.34: the 250 deg C bake is above the PEEK Tg), and then this surface IS etched; (2) the press-fit joint really masks the etch - never measured, while 01_02 1.3 Step 4 claims the etch reaches the WHOLE surface uniformly and opens with a vacuum pre-degassing whose purpose is to pull etchant into open volumes. Canon has NO masking line for this joint. Both conditions are one open verdict (00_07 HW.26).
notes.coating_restriction: NOT SPECIFIED, and deliberately so: the 01_02 3.6 map has a row for the Zone-1 gyroid wall and a row for the callus-contact periphery, and this press-fit shank is on NEITHER. Apply nothing without a verdict. The reason is not DET here but FIT: any coating of thickness t adds 2t of DIAMETRAL interference; 01_01 4.2 gives the nominal CLASS (H7/s6), and the tree's band is 5-34 um diametral from tools/in_silico/lib/constants.py - which is NOT that class: it is the H7/r6 read (s6 on O11 gives 10-39 um), and which class is meant is open (00_07 HW.3). ATTENTION on the band's PROVENANCE, corrected 2026-09-11 (00_07 HW.3): those micrometres are a plain ISO 286 table read (H7 0/+18 + r6 +23/+34 on O11), NOT a Lame result - Lame CONSUMES the band to compute a contact pressure and does not produce it. This matters because 01_01 4.2 requires the drawing's micrometres to come from the Lame interference window and explicitly REJECTS a blind ISO 286 lookup, so quoting the band as Lame-computed dresses the rejected source in the required source's name. Whether to re-derive the band is an open engineering verdict, not a wording question
notes.lattice_spec: Not applicable - solid shank, no lattice. (Printed as one body with the Zone-1 gyroid anode, whose lattice spec lives in cem/anchor_zone1.*.json)

DIN-471 groove to the real standard dimensions for this shaft diameter, CNC after printing.
